items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was sitting up on a dias with Walter Cronkite, Mike Wallace, and Roger Mudd.

ctx.x: You won a Peabody Award and an Emmy Award for that as well.

Yeah, and an Iris too. It was a wonderful script that I fashioned, because I just told the story of the hotel. I told it in rhyme as I had done with The Evolution of the Blues. The thrill of my creative life – one of the thrills was when I went to the Peabody presentations. I was sitting up on a dias with Walter Cronkite, Mike Wallace, and Roger Mudd. I was really excited by that. That was a high spot in my life, because that’s the highest award in the communications industry, and I was there with the people who…
It’s really remarkable. Those faces were in front of the American public almost every day, and there you were.
